testcase.name: SYNTHETIC WGS84/GCJ02 conversion and tagged-distance guard
arrival requires dwell and sample count; duplicate does not add count
departure requires separate dwell and hysteresis
600m accuracy is unknown and cannot accrue dwell
speed jump resets and cannot create ARRIVE/LEAVE
hidden/resume samples cannot bridge missing dwell
explicit suspend is pure and resets the next fresh interval
long gap starts new interval; out-of-order is ignored
overlapping fences choose exactly one nearest activity
same-day re-entry produces independent arrivalId
cross-day same POI triggers distinct activity and arrival
real and simulation isolation enforced
L3>L2>L1 priority emits at most one without writing shownAt
pause/busy suppress ordinary cards while enabled credible L3 passes
dedup ignores revision, actual shown/ignore facts matter
L2 once per intent per arrival; cooldown applies across activities
snooze and expiry rechecked, stale context rejected
real risks need verified evidence and risk dedup breaks ordinary cooldown
fact projection survives undo, correction latest wins and demo never pollutes
content applicability checks revision, POI and cancellation
queued arrival notification is filtered after leaving or losing position
DEMO corrections are replayed only in their own run
changing trip dates does not replay an arrival from the old day
